title: Greenwich se pehle samay Ujjain se napa jata tha?
hooks: Greenwich se pehle, poori duniya ka samay Ujjain se chalta tha.
Mahakal ka ek roop jo kaal ko bhi bandhe rakhta hai.
Dakshin mukhi kyun hai Mahakal? Raaz hai Shiv Puran mein.
hook_why: Shock-fact hook with named entities (Greenwich, Ujjain) and specific claim about world time reference — creates immediate curiosity loop; matches high-retention pattern of 'unknown history fact' openings in Indian shorts.
metaphor: Kaal Chakra — an ancient cosmic wheel of time with Mahakal at its center, controlling the flow of past, present, future; rendered in painterly Indian miniature style with gold zodiac bands and maroon spokes

cast.Mahakal: Serene four-armed form, ash-smeared blue skin, crescent moon on matted locks, third eye closed in calm, tiger skin draped, trident and damru in upper hands, lower hands in abhaya and varada mudra, facing south, soft golden divine light, warm gold and deep maroon palette, Indian miniature-meets-epic style
cast.Dushana: Dark-skinned asura, muscular, multiple arms wielding swords and maces, fierce red eyes, crown of skulls, menacing posture, rendered in same painterly style but with shadowed tones
cast.Raja Chandrasena: Royal attire in deep red and gold, crown with pearl strings, folded hands in devotion, calm peaceful face, seated on throne in temple courtyard
cast.Avanti Nagar: Ancient temple city on Shipra river banks, golden spires, stone ghats, banyan trees, soft morning mist, warm cinematic lighting

Greenwich se pehle poori duniya ka samay Ujjain se chalta tha. 🕉️ Mahakaleshwar ki katha jo kaal ko bhi bandhe rakhti hai — Shiv Puran ke Kotirudra Samhita se.

claims.claim: Ujjain (75.78°E) was the prime meridian for Hindu astronomical calculations before Greenwich
claims.basis: Surya Siddhanta and Indian astronomical tradition; Ujjain used as reference meridian for Hindu calendars and timekeeping

claims.claim: Mahakaleshwar is a dakshin mukhi (south-facing) Jyotirlinga
